::: {#lem-normal-equations-vector}
#### Normal equations in vector notation

Let

$$
A \eqdef \sumin \soprod{\vxi},
\qquad
\v{c} \eqdef \sumin \vxi \outvar_\iobs.
$$

The [normal equations](#def-normal-equations) of a simple linear regression
are equivalent to

$$A \vcoef = \v{c}.$$
:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-normal-equations-vector.

:::
